stem: Why is one dramatic close-up photo not enough to describe a room-wide IPM condition?
choices: The image may show one affected tissue without showing incidence, severity distribution or spatial pattern across the crop
Photos can only be used after harvest
Room maps are not useful for scouting
rationale: A close-up can document a sign or symptom, but representative sampling and spatial data are needed to determine how widely the condition occurs.
